en: An old sepia-toned postcard showing a valley with steep, barren hills on both sides and a cluster of light-colored industrial or monastic-looking buildings near the bottom of the slope. A chimney or small tower rises from the main rectangular building. Dirt roads and terraced slopes are visible in the landscape. At the top center of the card there is printed text in pre‑reform Cyrillic, and more text appears along the lower edge.
